message: Opening proposal for a standing agreement: $4.40 per unit, orders of 10 to 200 units, 15% paid at shipment and 85% on receipt, 8-day lead time with a half-day grace period, a 4% price cut per late day capped at 18%, a 10-day cancel window and a 12-day acceptance window. A person at our company must sign any final agreement.
